chunks: (As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says:) We have recorded a few portions here so that it may be known that he (peace be upon him) was establishing the pillar of truth and legislating examples of justice, in small matters and large, subtle and significant:

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرِّضَىٰ: Sayyid al-Radi, the compiler of Nahj al-Balagha

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali (AS) demonstrate justice in both major and minor matters according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sayyid al-Radi curates these excerpts to demonstrate that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) established the pillars of truth and modeled justice in both minor and major affairs, reflecting the comprehensive nature of his governance. This selection underscores the Shia scholarly view that his leadership was characterized by meticulous attention to detail, ensuring that legal and ethical principles were applied consistently across all levels of administration.
